_doc: SLOP-4: a widget submission IS an issue; the conversation with its reporter is COMMENTS. One pinned spec x4 (web comment-composer + comment-rows/regular, desktop comments.rs + issue composer, iOS CommentThreadView, Android RegularCommentRow + CommentThread). (1) A comment with source `reporter` has author_id NULL: the card names the submission's reporter (`widgets.submissionForIssue` reporterName, else `anonymousName`) and carries the `reporterCaption` after the time, exactly where `via MCP` sits for source `mcp`; its avatar is the initials fallback of that name. A member comment with audience `reporter` carries `toReporterCaption` in the same slot (the words left the team); `captions` pins the order when several apply and `authorNames` the name rules. A comment whose author row is missing and whose source is not `reporter` reads `formerMemberName`. (2) The composer offers the `toggleLabel` pill in the EXISTING composer's leading row (the slot the helpdesk Reply/Note pills used: web `Composer leading`, desktop `GlassComposer::leading`, iOS/Android GlassComposer leading) ONLY on an issue whose submission has a reporter email; the pill is OFF by default, toggles per composer, and never shows on reply composers under a card (replies are team-only). While ON the field placeholder is `placeholderOn` with `{name}` = the reporter name (else `anonymousName`), and submit sends `comments.create({audience: 'reporter'})`. (3) The create result carries `reporterEmailed` (true | false | null): true toasts `sentToast`, false toasts `notSentToast` (the comment is saved and shows on the reporter page either way), null = a team comment, no toast. (4) The reporter page (`/support/$token`, web only) lists the issue's reporter-audience comments; a reporter reply on a completed issue reopens it (status backlog). Notification `reporter_reply` rows use `notificationLabel`.

copy.notSentToast: Reply saved. No email was sent: this server has no mail transport.

captions._doc: The muted caption after the time. Parts in this ORDER: `reporterCaption` (source reporter), `toReporterCaption` (audience reporter on a non-reporter comment), `viaMcp` (source mcp); every part that applies shows, joined by `separator`; none = no caption. `copy` stays exactly nine keys; the caption-only strings live here.

authorNames._doc: The name a comment card carries. Source `reporter` (author_id NULL) = the submission's reporterName, else `anonymousName`. Any other source: a synced users row = that member's display name (`{author}` below); author_id set but no synced users row (left the team, deleted) = `formerMemberName`.
